ruling.explanation:
The charge stands and the driver is paid. What happened is not seriously in dispute on the instruments. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09101) places the driver stationary 24.0 m from the pickup pin — inside the 50 m arrival radius for a STANDARD zone — for a continuous 320 seconds, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 08:10:00 to the last at 08:15:20, and the trip record (EV-TRIP-09101) shows an 'arrived' event at 08:10:20 and the driver ending the trip at 08:15:20 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW and no boarding. That satisfies all four limbs of POL-NS-01: an arrival event; in-geofence presence at or before it; a 300-second minimum dwell measured from the first fix, here 320 seconds; and a driver-terminated no-show at or after the dwell elapsed. Neither advocate disputes the arrival marker, and none of POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the charge. POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) cannot apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius. POL-NS-05 (false marker) does not fire: the marker was set stationary at 0.0 km/h 24.01 m from the pin, neither beyond 300 m nor at the 15 km/h motion threshold. POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall) has no shortfall to remedy — the effective dwell exceeds the minimum by 20 seconds, the derived shortfall_sec is -20.0, and the only advisory artifact (EV-ADVIS-09101-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) is correctly conceded by the rider as giving no ground: a missing advisory makes accumulation unavailable and cannot excuse anything. On the rider's own case: the account that you were at the pickup point but could not see the car is not borne out. POL-NS-04 requires a locating or coordinating rider message in the chat log before it can exonerate you, and EV-CHAT-09101 holds only the system arrival notice at 08:10:21 and two driver messages (08:10:35, 08:14:10) — none from you — so limb (a) fails. Independence does not save it: the platform's rider track places your device 519.37 m from the pin with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, so limb (c) fails as well. Your account is a bare assertion filed the day after the trip and does not displace the instrument evidence. On compensation, POL-NS-07 pays 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not trip because driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4 (and 1 in 120 completed trips is far below 0.08). The fee is correctly itemised under POL-NS-08(d): the SGD 4.00 charged equals the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so no fare defect arises, and there is no clock skew, trace gap or chat truncation to down-weight the bundle. I have considered the rider's submission that the case should be escalated because the deciding margin is only 20 seconds, about 6.7 percent of the minimum, resting on a single derived computation. I do not accept it. POL-NS-09(a) escalates only where confidence falls below the 0.70 floor; here confidence is capped at 1.0 by the weight of the deciding artifacts (all at weight_multiplier 1.0) and I assess it at 0.95. No other POL-NS-09 trigger is met: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, and the sole-evidence impairment limb is not engaged. The narrowness of the margin is noted, but it is a point to attack with evidence, not a platform escalation trigger, and nothing in the bundle corroborates the rider's side of the window. The driver's two contemporaneous chat messages corroborate his account, but they do not carry this ruling — the arrival and dwell artifacts do, and they are unimpaired. The disputed SGD 4.00 is not refunded; SGD 3.20 goes to the driver under POL-NS-07.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

This ruling concerns the SGD 6.00 no-show cancellation fee charged after trip TRP-09102 on 2 September 2026.

To the rider: your dispute is not upheld on the evidence, and the SGD 6.00 charge stands. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-09102, weight 1.0) places his vehicle 24.01 m from the Changi T3 Door 5 pickup pin from the first fix at 22:40:00, with all 51 fixes inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius, so he did arrive under POL-NS-02. He then held position without moving for 500 seconds from 22:40:00 to 22:48:20, which is 20 seconds more than the 480-second AIRPORT minimum, and that dwell is measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix rather than from the 'arrived' marker, exactly as POL-NS-01(c) requires. The trip record (EV-TRIP-09102) shows no boarding event and a driver cancellation at 22:48:20 with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, at or after the dwell elapsed (POL-NS-01(d)). Your account that the driver 'cancelled while I was walking to the bay' is not what the record shows: your own device logged 24 fixes from 22:40:30 to 22:48:10 at a constant 519.47 m from the pin, outside the 200 m AIRPORT rider-presence radius. The waiting-period shortfall clause (POL-NS-06) does not refund you because there was no shortfall - the effective dwell of 500 seconds clears the 480-second bar, and no accumulation of separate intervals is needed. The rider-contact clause (POL-NS-04) is closed because the driver replied to your 22:41:40 message at 22:41:58, 18 seconds later, inside the 120-second window that disables the clause, and the wrong-entrance clause (POL-NS-03) does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not outside it. The driver's statement that he waited more than eight minutes at Door 5 and replied immediately is consistent with the instruments; it carries no weight of its own in the confidence calculation.

To the driver: your compensation is payable. Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 pays you 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 fee, which is SGD 4.80, the figure EV-FARE-09102 publishes at derived.money.driver_compensation. The anti-farming check is passed: your no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by 120 completed trips is 0.008, below the 0.08 ratio, so compensation is paid rather than withheld. The rider's SGD 6.00 charge is undisturbed and only the compensation moves; under POL-GEN-03 the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at the same SGD 4.80.

On confidence and integrity: every artifact that carries a deciding fact - the trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare breakdown and driver profile - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and none is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): the arrival timestamp matches a GPS fix exactly, the trace has 51 fixes and no gap over 120 seconds, the chat log holds the 4 messages the trip record counts and no gap over five minutes, and the SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the POL-NS-01 resolution rule, which takes the greater of the SGD 6.00 AIRPORT zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee. The only impaired artifact, EV-ADVIS-09102-01 (MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no deciding fact, so it neither caps the confidence nor escalates the case. No limb of POL-NS-09 is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other, the parties show no repeat no-show pairing in the trailing 90 days, the anti-farming check does not trip, and the only impaired artifact is not the sole evidence for any deciding fact. No clause produces a referral on these facts: POL-NS-05(ii) does not fire because the arrival marker is true (24.01 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h), and the POL-NS-07 escalation packet is not generated because the anti-farming gate does not trip.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Both parties accept the key timing facts, and they decide this case. The driver did arrive and was stationary inside the large-venue pickup geofence: EV-GPS-09103 shows 25 consecutive in-geofence fixes from 17:15:00 to 17:19:00, all about 24.0 m from the pin and inside the 120 m arrival radius, so the arrival conditions in POL-NS-02 are met. But POL-NS-01 requires a continuous in-geofence hold of at least the fee-schedule minimum of 300 seconds for a LARGE_VENUE pickup, measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrived marker. The first qualifying fix is at 17:15:00 and the trip was cancelled at 17:19:00, giving a dwell of 240 seconds. That is 60 seconds short, so POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails. The shortfall is even larger if measured from the driver's 17:15:20 arrived marker (about 220 seconds). POL-NS-06 then applies: where the effective in-geofence dwell is below the minimum for the zone class, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, whether or not the rider was present or responded. The fee charged was SGD 8.00, correctly calculated as the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), but the full SGD 8.00 must be returned. No driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-06 displaces POL-NS-07; the driver's good faith and stationary hold do not change the dwell requirement. There is no false-arrival referral under POL-NS-05(ii), because qualifying in-geofence fixes do exist, and no POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance or pin-ambiguity payment applies, because the driver was inside the arrival radius and there was only one registered pickup point. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09103-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), but it is not needed: POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the trace shows only one in-geofence interval, so accumulation cannot cure the shortfall. No POL-NS-08 impairment applies: there is no clock skew, no trace gap, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count and has no message-numbering hole, and the SGD 8.00 fare line reconciles with the resolution rule. No POL-NS-09 escalation is engaged: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the evidence is consistent, and no anti-farming or repeat-dispute trigger is met. The rider's absence and non-response are noted but, under POL-NS-06, do not defeat the refund.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-09104 is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the charge cannot stand. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable only if all four conditions hold. Condition (a) is met - EV-TRIP-09104 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 07:25:20. Conditions (b) and (c) are not. EV-GPS-09104 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) places the driver's device on all 37 of its fixes a minimum, mean and maximum of 559.37 m from the recorded pickup pin, records a qualifying in-radius fix count of 0 against the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and a longest qualifying in-geofence run of 0.0 s against the 300 s STANDARD minimum. The driver never entered the pickup geofence and never held position inside it, so under POL-NS-01(b)-(c) the fee is not chargeable.

For the rider. POL-NS-02 applies on its own terms: the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the 07:31:00 cancellation, so the driver never arrived and the fee is refunded in full. POL-NS-05 also fires: the 'arrived' marker at 07:25:20 places the driver more than 300 m from the pin, so the marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock; recomputed, there is no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full, awards no compensation, and directs the false-arrival record (see referrals). You need not rely on POL-NS-04 - its limb (a) has no rider message in EV-CHAT-09104 - and POL-NS-06 makes the refund independent of whether the rider was present or replied.

For the driver. I accept that you held position for about 5.7 minutes (single distinct speed 0.0 km/h over 37 fixes from 07:25:00 to 07:31:00), that you terminated the trip on RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event, and that the SGD 4.00 charge reconciles correctly: it is the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00) under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, and the fare reconciler reports a difference of 0.00. None of that changes the outcome. POL-NS-03 does not reach you: that clause's 400 m ceiling is the whole test and your stationary position was 559.37 m from the pin, so neither its wrong-entrance allocation nor the 50 percent pin-ambiguity goodwill is available - and registered_pickup_points on EV-TRIP-09104 is 1, below the 2 the goodwill limb requires. POL-NS-07 pays no compensation because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full. Your POL-NS-09(b) escalation argument is rejected: the arrival conflict between the trip record and the trace is not an unresolved contradiction - POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-05 are precisely the clauses that decide an arrival marker contradicted by the trace, and they resolve it here. Your point that the rider's own device also sits 519.46 m from the pin does not help either; POL-NS-06 makes the fee refundable whether or not the rider was present, and the policy forbids inferring that either point is the true pickup without a venue_id match or a party statement in the chat log, neither of which exists.

Weights and confidence. The deciding facts rest on EV-GPS-09104 and EV-TRIP-09104, both at weight 1.0. EV-ADVIS-09104-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is disclosed and citable, and its only effect is to make the POL-NS-06(i) dwell-accumulation route unavailable to either side - nothing is built on it. The trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08(a)-(d): no gaps (max_gap_sec 0.0), 37 fixes, chat message count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the fare reconciles. Confidence 0.90, above the 0.70 escalation floor, so no escalation arises.

Outcome: FULL_REFUND of the entire SGD 4.00 cancellation fee to the rider; no driver compensation; the false-arrival record referral stands.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii): record trip TRP-09104 as a false-arrival event against driver DRV-09104 in the false-arrival record.

ruling.explanation:
Both sides' accounts converge, and the record decides the case. The pickup was 'NEX Serangoon, Tower B ride-hail pickup' (venue VEN-NEX-SERANGOON), a LARGE_VENUE zone, so the POL-NS-02 arrival radius is 120 m and the POL-NS-01 minimum dwell is 300 seconds. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-09105, weight 1.0, 34 fixes, 100% coverage, max_gap_sec 0.0) shows the driver holding a single constant position 219.77 m from the pin at 0.0 km/h for the whole 330-second window from 13:05:00 to 13:10:30. He never entered the 120 m arrival radius — the arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-radius fixes and 0 runs, and longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec is 0.0 against the 300 s minimum. POL-NS-01 limb (b) therefore fails and limb (c) fails with it; the SGD 4.00 fee is not chargeable on the baseline test. Because the driver was nonetheless stationary for the required dwell at 219.77 m — outside the arrival radius but inside the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling — POL-NS-02 yields to POL-NS-03, which refunds the cancellation fee to the rider in full. On fault for compensation: the chat log (EV-CHAT-09105, weight 1.0) shows the rider naming the correct sub-location at 13:05:05 ('I am at Tower B ride-hail pickup, beside the blue sign') and repeating 'Please come to Tower B' at 13:06:35, while the driver's only message places him at 'the mall taxi stand'; the driver's own statement concedes he waited at a mall entrance 'but did not move to Tower B'. Under POL-NS-03(i) the driver bears the loss and receives no compensation, so driver_compensation_sgd is null and nothing is netted against the rider's refund. I have weighed the remaining contentions. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at 13:05:20 the driver was 219.77 m from the pin (under the 300 m trigger) and at 0.0 km/h (under the 15 km/h trigger), so the arrival marker is not false and no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral attaches — the advocates agree and the record confirms it. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: her locating message was answered at 13:06:00, 55 seconds later and inside the 120-second window, so POL-NS-04's own closing direction applies and the residual mislocation goes to POL-NS-03, which refunds the fee in any event. The rider's independent POL-NS-06 route to the same outcome (zero effective in-geofence dwell) also holds; the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09105-01 (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes only the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation option and is not held against either party. No POL-NS-08 limb is engaged: no clock skew (the 13:05:20 'arrived' event sits on the 10-second fix grid), no trace gap, a chat log whose 4 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count, and a SGD 4.00 fee that equals the GREATER of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00). No POL-NS-09 escalation limb fires: there is no direct contradiction on arrival, dwell or rider presence; disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both profiles; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test does not trip (1 no-show termination in 30 days against 120 completed trips, ratio 0.008). The lifetime counters (prior_no_show_flags, prior_disputes_filed, prior_disputes_upheld, rating) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and have carried no weight. The deciding facts are carried by unimpaired artifacts at weight 1.0, so confidence is not capped below the 0.70 floor. Ruling: the SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged to the rider is refunded in full; the driver receives no compensation.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

Driver and rider: this case turns on the chat record, and it goes in the rider's favour.

On the driver's side, the claims that the no-show charge was earned are accepted as facts. The driver's own GPS trace and trip record show he met POL-NS-01 limb by limb: he was 24.0 m from the pickup pin, stationary (0.0 km/h across all 34 fixes), inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius from 18:20:00, which is before the 18:20:20 'arrived' marker; he held that position for a single continuous qualifying run of 330 seconds against the 300-second TRANSPORT_HUB minimum (the dwell measured from the first qualifying fix, not the marker); and he terminated at 18:25:30 on code RIDER_NO_SHOW, 30 seconds after the minimum elapsed, with no boarding event. The POL-NS-02 arrival gate is passed; the POL-NS-05 false-arrival test is not engaged (he was stationary and 24 m from the pin, so the marker is true and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed); POL-NS-06 is not engaged because a 330-second run leaves no shortfall; and the SGD 6.00 fee reconciles with the fee schedule under POL-NS-08(d), being the greater of the SGD 6.00 TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee and the SGD 6.00 RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (a tie at SGD 6.00). Those claims do not decide the case, because POL-NS-01 makes the fee chargeable 'ONLY IF' no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it.

POL-NS-04 displaces it. The chat log shows the rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: at 18:21:00, 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' (her own position and a specific entrance, and a request for the driver's position), and at 18:23:25, 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' (a statement that she cannot see the vehicle). The driver posted no reply at any point and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so he neither replied within 120 seconds nor called before terminating; the read receipts show he opened both messages (18:21:15 and 18:23:40) and stayed silent until cancelling. The rider's own track places her device at 41.9 m from the pin on all 16 qualifying fixes (rider_fix_count and rider_qualifying_fix_count both 16), inside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius for 100 percent of fixes, more than the majority limb (c) requires. All three limbs of POL-NS-04 hold, so the rider is exonerated and the cancellation fee is refunded in full. The driver's claim to 80 percent of the fee — SGD 4.80 under POL-NS-07 — is rejected: POL-NS-07 applies only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied 'and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it', and POL-NS-04 both displaces it and states expressly that no driver compensation is payable. The anti-farming check not tripping (no_show_terminations_30d 1, ratio 0.008) therefore does not matter.

On the figures: the contested amount and the single charged line are the same SGD 6.00 (fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee 6.00, total_charged 6.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, all other fare lines 0.00). A full refund returns SGD 6.00 and no driver compensation is payable.

Two further points. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09106-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0; the rider's claim resting on it was discarded by the referee and appears in the audit record, and in any event POL-NS-06 limb (i) accumulation is never reached because there is no shortfall, so the missing advisory changes nothing. No artifact carrying the deciding facts is impaired: the GPS trace is COMPLETE at weight 1.0 with 34 fixes, a 10-second interval, zero gaps and a present rider track; the chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 on an unbroken msg_id sequence 001-003; and the arrived timestamp coincides with a GPS fix, so POL-NS-08(a) to (d) are not engaged and no confidence discount or escalation follows. No escalation limb is engaged either: confidence is not below the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d fields are 0 (limb (c) needs 2), no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (limb (d) needs 3), and no deciding fact rests on impaired evidence (limb (e)). No clause produces a referral, so none is recorded.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and nothing is returned to you. Your case is that the driver's two waits must be counted separately and so the sustained hold never reached 300 seconds. The policy answers that point directly. POL-NS-06(i) lets dwell be accumulated across separate in-geofence intervals within a single pickup attempt where the driver leaves and re-enters without ever travelling more than 300 m from the pin AND a traffic advisory whose geometry covers the pickup road and whose window covers the waiting period carries type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT, such that holding position was not lawfully possible. Here EV-ADVIS-09107-01 is present and populated: type CLOSURE, geometry covering the Orchard Central pickup road, active 18:50 to 19:30, which spans the whole waiting window. The driver's furthest point between the two intervals was 179.8 m from the pin, inside the 300 m leash. The intervals therefore sum: 170 s (19:00:00–19:02:50) plus 160 s (19:03:50–19:06:30) is 330 s, which clears the 300 s LARGE_VENUE minimum by 30 seconds — there is no shortfall, and the rider's argument that the longest continuous run is only 170 s is answered by POL-NS-06(i), which is the policy's own computation of the effective in-geofence dwell. To the driver: your compensation is payable. The arrival test in POL-NS-02 is satisfied — 35 of your 40 fixes are qualifying in-radius fixes against a 3-fix requirement — and POL-NS-05 does not treat the arrival marker as false: you marked arrival 20 seconds after the first qualifying in-geofence fix, stationary in the bay, not within any 300 m / 15 km/h trigger, so the waiting clock is not recomputed. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply because you were inside the arrival radius, and POL-NS-04 does not apply because the rider sent no locating or coordinating message at all and their device sat about 519 m from the pin throughout. POL-NS-08 is clean: no clock skew, no trace gap, 3 chat messages against a recorded count of 3, and the fee reconciles (the greater of the 4.00 LARGE_VENUE zone fee and the 4.00 RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee is 4.00, which is what was charged). You are therefore owed 80 percent of the 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, the residual 0.80 being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by 120 completed trips is 0.0083 (below 0.08). No clause produces a referral, and no escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged, since every artifact in the bundle is admissible at weight 1.0. The rider's charge stands as itemised; the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION because that is the outcome the case produces.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee is chargeable on the merits, but the driver's compensation is withheld and the case must go to a human reviewer. On the fee: all four POL-NS-01 conditions hold. (a) trip_record EV-TRIP-09108 carries a driver arrival event at 2026-09-08T09:30:20. (b) GPS trace EV-GPS-09108 places the driver 24.01 m from the pickup pin, inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, from 09:30:00, before that event. (c) the driver held position for a continuous 330 seconds (longest qualifying in-geofence run, 09:30:00-09:35:30), above the 300-second LARGE_VENUE minimum. (d) the trip terminated with no boarding, by the driver, with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW. None of the displacing clauses applies: POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) requires the driver to be outside the arrival radius - he was 24.01 m from the pin; POL-NS-04 (rider contact) never opens because chat log EV-CHAT-09108 holds only the system arrival notice and the driver's own message, with no rider message; POL-NS-05 (false arrival) fails because the driver was 24.01 m from the pin at a recorded speed of 0.0 km/h, far from the 300 m and 15 km/h thresholds; POL-NS-06 (dwell shortfall) has no shortfall - the 330-second hold exceeds the 300-second minimum by 30 seconds (shortfall_sec -30.0). The rider is right not to press the shortfall route, and traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09108-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is neither available nor needed. On compensation: the POL-NS-07 formula would yield SGD 3.20 (80% of the SGD 4.00 fee, itself the greater of the LARGE_VENUE zone-class fee and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee, both SGD 4.00). But the anti-farming check trips: driver_profile EV-DPROF-09108 shows no_show_terminations_30d = 7 (4 or more) and 7 / 70 completed_trips_30d = 0.10 (greater than 0.08). Compensation is therefore WITHHELD and the case escalates under POL-NS-09(d), which names a tripped POL-NS-07 check as its own mandatory trigger. The rider's escalation claims are accepted: escalation is terminal, no monetary ruling issues, and the SGD 4.00 (payment_status PENDING, charged_at null, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, total_charged 4.0) is held rather than collected or refunded. The rider's own citable counters are clean - no_show_disputes_30d = 0 and the parties' disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 - so the escalation is driven entirely by the driver's anti-farming figures. The rider's argument that NO_ACTION would leave the PENDING charge on the rider is moot: the outcome here is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. Confidence is 0.90, capped by the weight of the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (EV-DPROF-09108, EV-GPS-09108, EV-TRIP-09108 and EV-FARE-09108, all weight_multiplier 1.0); no POL-NS-08 impairment applies (arrival/GPS clock offset 20 s, no trace gap, chat count matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the 4.00 fare reconciles with the resolution_rule). The escalation packet directs the human reviewer, per POL-NS-07, to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.00 in full.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this case is escalated to a human reviewer and the disputed SGD 4.00 cancellation fee is placed on hold. While review is pending the fee is neither collected from the rider nor refunded, and no driver compensation is paid.

WHY ESCALATE. POL-NS-09(c) is a mandatory escalation trigger and it fires. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d on EV-RPROF-09110 is 2, and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d on EV-DPROF-09110 is 2. Read together they show two or more no-show disputes between the same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days, and the rider's own filing describes this as 'another dispute with the same driver'. These are precisely the two fields POL-GEN-01 makes citable for this test, so nothing here rests on a context-only counter: the lifetime prior_no_show_flags field mentioned in the rider's brief is not used and carries no weight. Under POL-GEN-03 escalation is terminal and replaces any monetary outcome.

OPEN QUESTION FOR THE REVIEWER. Whether the repeated no-show disputes between this rider and this driver (2 shown on each profile in the trailing 90 days) indicate abuse on either side or a systemic pick-up problem between these two parties, and how the held fee should be disposed of once that pattern question is settled. The reviewer receives both advocate briefs, the admissibility pre-pass report, the clauses relied on (POL-NS-01 to POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-01, POL-GEN-02, POL-GEN-03) and this reasoning.

THE DRIVER'S MERITS (made out, but the escalation is terminal). POL-NS-01 limbs (a) to (d) all hold on admissible evidence. (a) The trip record carries the driver 'arrived' event at 06:50:20. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-09110 places 34 qualifying fixes at 24.01 m inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius from 06:50:00, at or before that event, so the POL-NS-02 proximity test is satisfied. (c) The continuous in-geofence hold ran 330 seconds from 06:50:00 against the 300-second STANDARD minimum (shortfall -30.0 s, a 30-second surplus), measured from the first qualifying fix and not from the arrival marker. (d) The trip was terminated by the driver at 06:55:30 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell elapsed at 06:55:00, with no boarding event recorded. POL-NS-06 gives no refund because there is no shortfall; the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09110-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), so the limb (i) accumulation route is unavailable and nothing may be asserted against a missing artifact. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: at the arrival marker the driver was stationary (single distinct speed 0.0 km/h) at 24 m, inside both the 50 m radius and the clause's 300 m ceiling, so the marker is true. POL-NS-03 cannot apply because the driver was never outside the arrival radius. The SGD 4.00 fee reconciles exactly with the greater of the STANDARD zone-class fee (SGD 4.00) and the RYDE_X vehicle-tier fee (SGD 4.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect, and there is no POL-NS-08(a) to (c) impairment (max GPS gap 0 s, 34 fixes across the window, 4 chat messages matching the trip record's chat_message_count of 4). Compensation under POL-NS-07 would be 80 percent of SGD 4.00, namely SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1 divided by 120 completed trips is far below 0.08. That compensation is withheld only because the escalation is terminal; it is not denied on the merits.

THE RIDER'S OTHER ROUTES DO NOT INDEPENDENTLY HELP. POL-NS-04 fails: the driver replied 'Okay, waiting' at 06:52:00, twenty seconds after the rider's 06:51:40 'Coming down now', inside the clause's 120-second window, so limb (b) fails on the chat log; and the rider's device sat 519.36 m from the pin with rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 of 16 fixes, failing limb (c) affirmatively against the 100 m STANDARD presence radius. The rider's only working route is the escalation just described.

CONFIDENCE. The deciding fact - the two-counterparty-dispute pattern - is carried by EV-RPROF-09110 and EV-DPROF-09110, two independent artifacts each at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. Confidence is 0.90, above the 0.70 floor, so no separate escalation under POL-NS-09(a) is needed.

NO REFERRAL. No clause that produces a referral fires: POL-NS-05(ii) does not (qualifying in-geofence fixes exist), and POL-NS-07's packet instruction to refund the rider does not (the anti-farming check does not trip). The open question above therefore sits in this explanation, not in the referrals list.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-09111-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 6.00 no-show fee on trip TRP-09109 is placed ON HOLD — neither collected nor refunded — and the case goes to a human reviewer. On this record I can neither confirm the charge nor order a refund.

WHY THE FEE CANNOT BE CONFIRMED OR DEFEATED. POL-NS-01 makes a no-show fee chargeable ONLY IF four conditions hold, and two of them are GPS conditions: (b) the trace places the driver inside the 150 m Transport-Hub arrival radius for the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay at or before the 21:10:20 'arrived' marker, and (c) the trace shows a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least 300 seconds, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and expressly NOT from the 'arrived' marker. The GPS trace EV-GPS-09109 is MISSING — issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, BLOCKING, weight 0.0, 'no driver-device or platform GPS export exists for the waiting window'. Under POL-GEN-02 a missing artifact carries no fact and only its absence is citable, and under POL-NS-08(b) the window holds zero fixes (fewer than six). Limbs (b) and (c) therefore cannot be run at all. A test that never ran decides nothing in either direction: it neither supports the SGD 6.00 charge (which needs limbs (b) and (c) to hold) nor a refund (which needs them to fail). Limbs (a) and (d) are satisfied on the trip record (arrived marker 21:10:20; terminated 21:15:40 by the driver with RIDER_NO_SHOW, no boarding, no started_at) and the platform's recorded wait of 5.3 minutes is consistent with the 300-second minimum — but limb (c) does not accept the arrived marker as the dwell measure.

THE RIDER'S CLAIMS. Her central claim — that the missing trace makes limbs (b) and (c) 'fail' and yields a full refund of the SGD 6.00 — is rejected as to direction: absence is not a failed test, and POL-NS-08 caps a ruling resting on impaired deciding evidence at PARTIAL_REFUND and sends it to POL-NS-09, so the outcome is escalation, not a refund. Her POL-NS-02 argument ('no qualifying in-radius fix') also fails: that clause's 'never arrived' result presupposes a trace that ran and found nothing, and here there is no trace. Her reliance on the counterparty statement ('I was at the bay for the full waiting period, but the GPS export is unavailable'), the system prompt 'Your driver has arrived' (21:10:21) and the chat lines ('I am at the private-hire bay', 21:10:40; 'I am at the bay and cannot see your car', 21:11:30; 'I am here beside the sign', 21:11:45) is answered: these are contemporaneous and I have read them, but they are accounts offered where the GPS test admitted no reading at all, so they neither decide limbs (b)/(c) nor lift the confidence cap. The counterparty statement carries no weight and so enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of that cap. Her point that the thin 320-second span (21:10:20 to 21:15:40) is on the wrong clock for limb (c) is correct, and it cuts both ways. Her profile claim is accepted: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) and (d) are not engaged, and prior_no_show_flags is context only under POL-GEN-01 and was not used.

THE DRIVER'S CLAIMS. His main claim — that the absent trace cannot be turned against him, so the SGD 6.00 stands (NO_ACTION) — is rejected: the fee is chargeable only if limbs (b) and (c) hold, they are undecided, and an undecided limb cannot support leaving a SGD 6.00 charge in place. His alternative — that the arrival test cannot be run, that the only evidence for the deciding fact is therefore impaired, and that escalation with the fee held is required — is the one I adopt. His remaining points are accepted: the anti-farming check does not trip (no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below 4; 1/120 ≈ 0.008, below 0.08), so no compensation is withheld and the SGD 4.80 figure is not payable; POL-NS-04 is unavailable (the driver replied 15 seconds after the rider's locating message, so limb (b) fails); POL-NS-05(ii) cannot fire without a trace; and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-09109-01 is MISSING (BLOCKING, weight 0.0), so POL-NS-06(i) cannot be used to sum separate in-geofence intervals — its absence neither defeats nor supports the charge on its own.

OTHER CHECKS. The chat log is intact (four messages, matching trip_record.chat_message_count = 4, no sequence gap), so no POL-NS-08(c) defect. The fare line reconciles — the greater of the SGD 6.00 Transport-Hub zone fee and the SGD 4.00 RYDE_X tier fee is SGD 6.00, and payment_status is PENDING with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — so no POL-NS-08(d) defect.

CONFIDENCE AND TRIGGERS. The only artifact that could carry the deciding fact — whether the driver arrived and held the bay — is EV-GPS-09109 at weight 0.0, and no independent admissible artifact carries it; confidence is therefore capped at 0.0, below the 0.70 floor (POL-NS-09(a)), and the same impairment makes it the sole impaired evidence for the deciding fact (POL-NS-09(e)). No referral is issued, and the SGD 6.00 is held meanwhile.

FOR THE REVIEWER: please establish from device or platform telemetry whether the driver was inside the 150 m radius of the Woodlands MRT private-hire bay pin at or before 21:10:20 and held continuously for at least 300 seconds before cancelling at 21:15:40. If arrival and dwell are confirmed, the SGD 6.00 fee stands; if not, it is refunded in full.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Both parties agree on the arithmetic, and it decides the case. POL-RD-01 establishes a route deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of the optimal distance AND greater than 0.8 km, with both tests passing. The governing measurement is gps_trace.trace_distance_km (EV-GPS-09112) at 11.5 km against the booked optimal distance of 10.0 km on the trip record (EV-TRIP-09112): an excess of 1.5 km. That is 15.00% of optimal, so the percentage limb fails. The absolute limb (1.5 km over 0.8 km) passes, but the test is conjunctive, so no deviation is established on this trip's own evidence, and POL-RD-01 directs NO_ACTION however the rider characterises the trip. For the rider: your '1.5 km longer' figure is accepted as the correct measurement, but 1.5 km is 15% of the 10.0 km route shown at booking, and the policy's gate is above 20%; the trip was longer, but not by enough for the policy to open a distance refund. For the driver: no finding of fault is made against you, and nothing is deducted. The GPS trace was checked and is clean — 133 fixes at 10-second intervals, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum inter-fix gap of 0.0 s — so POL-RD-07 is not engaged, the trace is admitted at full value, and no independent corroboration or escalation under POL-RD-10(3) arises. The two further routes to money that survive a failed threshold do not open on this record. First, POL-RD-02's fare recomputation is reached only where a deviation is first established, so it is never triggered; the figures the rider recorded for visibility (charged_total 19.39, recomputed_fare 17.70, refund 1.69 rounded up to 1.70) are noted but are not applied. Second, a billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) requires an unmatched gantry or a wrongly applied surcharge; the fare breakdown itemises no ERP gantries at all (erp_gantries empty, on-route and off-route ERP totals 0.00) and carries no airport surcharge line, so there is nothing to refund as a standalone correction. No traffic advisory covers this trip: EV-ADVIS-09112-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fired issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact and the driver has no POL-RD-03 exoneration available — that absence does not help the rider either, since the claim already fails on the threshold. POL-RD-04 cannot exonerate or excuse anything: the only chat message (EV-CHAT-09112, 14:21:40) is the rider's own observation that the ride looked longer, it identifies no road or place, and chat_message.waypoint_hint is null, so there is no rider instruction to act on. The rider's profile (EV-RPROF-09112) was cited only for the POL-RD-08 corroboration gate (deviation_claims_60d 0, substantiated 0), which is far below the 4-or-more / 1-or-fewer gate, so no extra corroboration burden applies; no profile field is used as a ground of decision. Outcome: the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence and the present state stands. The fare of 19.39 remains CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd at 0.00, and no refund, driver payment or referral issues. Confidence is 0.9, capped by the weight of the GPS trace and trip record that carry the deciding measurement (both 1.0), well above the 0.70 floor, so no escalation is triggered.

detail: the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-09114-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. Everything turns on one charge line: the SGD 3.20 ERP line for the gantry 'Bukit Merah Central westbound', charged at 2026-09-21T11:43:00 on trip TRP-09114. Rider — you are refunded the full SGD 3.20 you contested, which is the whole of the contested amount. Your ride was an upfront-quoted fare: the booking quoted SGD 22.00 and the ledger's total_charged is SGD 25.20. The entire SGD 3.20 difference is that single ERP line — airport_surcharge and waiting_time_fee are both 0.00, and the base, distance, time and platform-fee lines all sit inside the SGD 22.00 quote. The GPS trace for this trip is complete and unimpaired: 169 fixes at a 10-second sample interval, coverage_pct 100.0, gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0, running 11:30:00 to 11:58:00. Against that trace the gantry's coordinates (lat 1.34, lng 103.78) lie 7,482.07 m from the nearest fix, index 65 at 11:40:50 — nowhere near the 250 m radius POL-RD-09 uses to treat a fix as a crossing. The vehicle never passed the gantry, so under POL-RD-09(4) the line is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded in full as a standalone correction, available whether or not any deviation exists; that limb expressly does not trigger POL-RD-10(8) where it is the only unmatched line. POL-RD-11(a) reaches the same SGD 3.20 independently: on an upfront quote only pass-throughs actually incurred (ERP and tolls crossed, a properly chargeable airport surcharge, waiting_time_fee) may sit on top of the quoted fare, and this one was not incurred. The final amount payable is rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05 and SGD 3.20 is unchanged. Driver — nothing is found against you on the money and nothing is taken from you. The trace records 16.0 km against the 12.5 km optimal route, an excess of 3.5 km (28.00%), which clears POL-RD-01's two establishment tests (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but is below both materiality thresholds (50% and 8.0 km absolute), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged and no driver-conduct referral issues; in any event your profile shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 against 610 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat-deviation pattern exists. POL-RD-11 means the distance and time charges on an upfront-quoted trip are fixed at booking, so no fare recomputation runs against you, and your unrecovered cost on an unjustified detour is not recoverable from the rider under that clause. Your own statement that the route 'was longer than expected' but that you 'did not see or pass the gantry named on the receipt' corroborates the trace; note that a counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so it supports the finding but does not enter the confidence cap. Confidence is 0.95, within the cap of 1.0: the deciding fact — that the gantry was never crossed — is carried by two independent artifacts at weight 1.0, the GPS trace EV-GPS-09114 and the fare breakdown EV-FARE-09114. Claims considered: both sides agree POL-RD-11 governs and that the only recoverable item on this fare is the SGD 3.20 ERP line — accepted, and it is the outcome. The rider's POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity claim — accepted, producing both the refund and the referral above. The rider's POL-RD-01 deviation finding of 3.5 km / 28.00% — accepted, but on an upfront quote it moves no money. The POL-RD-06 materiality and repeat-pattern points from both sides — accepted; no material deviation, no pattern, no conduct referral. The rider's POL-RD-07 trace-integrity claim — accepted; the trace is unimpaired, so no corroboration or down-weighting rule is engaged. The rider's POL-RD-04 chat-log claim — accepted; the log holds one rider message at 11:53:00 with waypoint_hint null, naming no road or place and sent after the 11:43:00 charge, so it is no detour instruction and POL-RD-09(3) does not defeat the ERP refund. The rider's POL-RD-03 point that no advisory exists — accepted; the only advisory artifact, EV-ADVIS-09114-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0, so no closure or advisory can exonerate anything. A POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral is recorded in the rulings list; it rides with the money and does not displace it. Open question for the reviewer, which belongs here rather than in the referrals list: why a gantry 7.5 km off the driven corridor was billed at all — the record shows no system cause, and the reviewer may wish to trace the ERP billing source.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity: refund as a standalone pass-through correction the SGD 3.20 'Bukit Merah Central westbound' ERP line charged at 2026-09-21T11:43:00 on TRP-09114 — the GPS trace never comes within the 250 m match radius of the gantry (nearest fix 7,482.07 m), so the line is a billing-integrity failure and is refunded whether or not a deviation exists.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you converge on the same arithmetic, and it is right - but the fare hides one further defect that changes the total. The trip: TRP-09113 ran 18.0 km on the governing gps_trace (EV-GPS-09113) against a booked optimal of 10.0 km (EV-TRIP-09113), an excess of 8.0 km / 80%, both above POL-RD-01's 20% and 0.8 km tests. The LTA advisory (EV-ADVIS-09113-01) is a genuine external closure: it names the Pelton Canal Link eastbound connector, a segment the booked optimal route traverses, its 18:14-18:55 window covers the 18:20-18:54 trip, and the actual route leaves the corridor before the affected segment and rejoins it after. POL-RD-03 therefore excuses part of the excess, but only up to its cap: min(8.0, 1.30 x (12.0 - 10.0) + 1.00) = 3.60 km, giving a closure-adjusted optimal of 13.60 km / 27.2 min. The residual 4.40 km still clears POL-RD-01, so a refund is due; it is below both the 50% and the 8.0 km materiality limbs, so POL-RD-06 is not engaged - and in any event the driver's profile shows no repeat pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral). POL-RD-02 recomputation against the adjusted route: 3.80 + (0.75 x 13.60 = 10.20) + (0.28 x 27.2 = 7.616) = 21.616; + 0.80 platform fee + 1.00 on-optimal-route ERP = recomputed fare 23.416 against a charged total of 31.42. Refund = 31.42 - 23.416 = 8.004, rounded up to SGD 8.05 - a partial refund, since it clears the 0.50 de-minimis floor and is only 25.5% of charged_total, far below the 90% full-refund share. The SGD 2.80 off-route 'Industrial loop exit' ERP is already comprehended in that figure (POL-RD-09(1)) and is not added on top. POL-RD-04 adds nothing: neither chat message carries a waypoint_hint and the rider names no road, so its corroboration test cannot be run and the case is decided on the remaining clauses. No driver compensation is due - the billed distance (18.0 km) does not fall short of the trace. THE EXTRA ITEM: the fare also charges SGD 1.00 for the 'Pelton lawful diversion entry' gantry. That gantry sits on the booked optimal route, but the trace never passes it - the nearest fix is 834.18 m away, far outside the 250 m match radius POL-RD-09 applies - so under POL-RD-09(4) it is a billing-integrity failure, refunded in full as a standalone correction. That is why the amount is 8.05 + 1.00 = 9.05 rather than 8.05, and why the case carries a referral. It is not an escalation: POL-RD-09(4) expressly does not trigger POL-RD-10(8), and the driver's submission that 'no greater sum may be awarded' is rejected for that reason. Nothing else escalates: the trace is complete (205 fixes at 10 s, no gaps), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged; identifiers and timestamps match; and no other POL-RD-10 trigger fires. The rider's profile adds no corroboration burden (deviation_claims_60d 0). Every artifact relied on carries weight 1.0, and confidence stands at 0.85, above the 0.70 floor.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing integrity: the SGD 1.00 'Pelton lawful diversion entry' ERP charge on EV-FARE-09113 is for a gantry the gps_trace EV-GPS-09113 never passes (nearest fix 834.18 m, outside the 250 m match radius); it is refunded in full as a standalone correction and recorded as a billing-integrity finding.

ruling.explanation:
ESCALATE. The disputed SGD 5.80 is held — neither collected from the rider nor refunded — and the fare's present state (charged_total SGD 26.60, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, payment_status CHARGED) stands pending human review.

This is a data failure, not a finding against either party. The GPS trace EV-GPS-09115 is impaired: admissibility status IMPAIRED, issue code GPS_GAP, weight_multiplier 0.6. It carries a 160-second gap between consecutive fixes (20:03:10 to 20:05:50 SGT) sitting inside the very segment in dispute, above POL-RD-07's 90-second limit, so it is impaired for policy purposes and not merely discounted at schema level. The whole 4.0 km excess (trace 15.0 km vs booked optimal 11.0 km, 36.4%) is carried only by that impaired trace. POL-RD-07(ii) sets a closed list of independent corroboration and none of it is present: the chat log EV-CHAT-09115 (weight 1.0) holds no driver admission — the driver wrote only that his navigation display also refreshed and that he continued to the destination; the fare breakdown EV-FARE-09115 (weight 1.0) shows no ERP gantries and no toll lines, so nothing places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use; the driver's counterparty statement denies any extra stop or detour request rather than admitting the route; and trip_record.actual_distance_km (15.0 km on EV-TRIP-09115) is, per POL-RD-01, a rounded convenience copy of the trace figure, not an independent derivation. With the trace impaired and uncorroborated, POL-RD-07(iii) directs ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION, and POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory.

The confidence floor is breached independently. The excess rests solely on EV-GPS-09115 at weight 0.6, so POL-GEN-02(2) caps my confidence at 0.6, below the 0.70 platform-wide floor read from the policy (POL-RD-10(1), POL-GEN-02). POL-GEN-02(3) requires me to name the artifact, its weight and its issue codes: EV-GPS-09115, weight 0.6, issue GPS_GAP, and the finding does not survive the discount at the level the policy requires. That same artifact is the reason the case cannot be decided either way.

To the rider: your POL-RD-01 arithmetic is correct on its face — 4.0 km and 36.4% clear both the 0.8 km and 20% establishment tests — and your POL-RD-02 figures would be the right refund if a deviation were established (charged_total 26.60, recomputed_fare 20.8310, refund 5.7690 rounded up to 5.80, above the 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share). Your point that a straight-line re-measurement across the gap (1.35 km) leaves most of the excess intact is also sound — but the bar here is independent corroboration, not re-measurement, and your observation that escalation leaves the SGD 5.80 held rather than charged is exactly right. Payouts under POL-RD-02 nonetheless cannot issue while the only measurement of the excess is the impaired trace. Your POL-RD-08 gate point is accepted: deviation_claims_60d 0 does not require extra corroboration of you, but that gate is not what blocks the claim.

To the driver: your points are accepted — no chat-log admission of a detour (POL-RD-04 unavailable, waypoint_hint null), no ERP or surcharge line to correct (POL-RD-09 has nothing to pass through), no traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09115-01 is MISSING, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, and can carry no fact), and no repeat-deviation pattern (deviation_flags_90d 0 over 610 completed_trips_90d), so no POL-RD-06 conduct referral fires. But an impaired, uncorroborated trace is a data failure the policy sends to a human reviewer, not a finding for you, so NO_ACTION is not available on this record.

What would resolve it: an independent record of the vehicle's path across the 160-second gap — a traffic advisory covering that corridor and window, an off-corridor ERP gantry crossing, an admission from either party, or a trip-record actual distance derived independently of this trace.

No referral issues: no clause produces one on these facts (no POL-RD-06 pattern and no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity defect).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
